comparison: Incremental LP3 changes against the previous review-branch tip, not against main.
timingScope: One retained Chrome pair; the first overlapping attempt was discarded. Three <=20% utilization samples precede each retained run. No guarantee of quiet GPU throughout the runs.
fixture: green-modern-2 authored strokes translated +2048 in x and y; metadata source removed; same scene and URL knobs in both builds.
timedCodeNote: After the retained pair, overflow retries gained a queue drain before freeing the rejected pool, and the preflight rejection history was bounded to 128 entries. The measured previews had no overflow. Quick pool and final-byte proofs used the final code.

No editor files are changed; Fetch injects timing-only observers before modules execute.
